high_level_description: This image captures a stunning night sky filled with vibrant auroras. The auroras display a mix of colors, predominantly green at the bottom transitioning into pinkish-red hues towards the top. The sky is dotted with stars, adding to the celestial beauty of the scene. Below the auroras, silhouettes of trees are visible, providing a stark contrast against the illuminated sky. The overall setting appears to be a remote or rural area, as there are no buildings or artificial lights disrupting the natural view.
